name: Color Key color sets
note: The sets a visitor can choose under "Make it yours", besides the reference colors. The reference colors are data/language.json and have no entry here, so the agreed hues stay in one place. Each set gives every family its two shades (three-note chord, seventh chord), the gray of a chord with no reading, and the twelve note colors of Pitch Color, from C upward.

sets.name: Soft
sets.say: The same hues with less saturation. Not the set for red-green color vision.
sets.source: Derived from the reference colors by calculation: every hue kept, saturation held under a ceiling, lightness moved a little to keep the families apart.

sets.name: Red-green
sets.say: For red-green color vision. Tuned by simulation, and not yet tried with color-blind readers.
sets.source: The nine families are the candidate of the project's color-vision search (decision D040, run palette-cvd-20260922), not adopted as the reference. The twelve note colors were searched for with the same measure.
